scope: Normalize only intentional locale selector value in owned equality while checking its actual requested value on every paint
reason: The earlier blanket control-value invariant incorrectly froze the locale selector value, which must change with the requested locale. This was an acceptance-contract false positive; the actual failed run is preserved.
allowed_normalization: Only the value field of the actual element whose identity equals document.querySelector(#locale) is replaced by [requested-locale] in the two owned snapshots. No other control field is normalized.
confirmed_source_guards: Both initial EN/JA baseline paints check exactly one #locale and actual selector.value equal requested locale before storing full DOM baseline.
Every one of the100 measured transitions checks the unique selector and requested value before fullDOM/history invariant comparison.
Exact paintLocale checks the unique selector and requested value inside its registered-only paint guard.
Full DOM snapshots keep all actual control values, including the locale selector value, plus outerHTML/canvas/translation metadata/focus/scroll.
Both owned snapshots retain every other control ID/tag/type/value/checked/caret; exact paint owns focus and shared preparation/DOM comparisons retain focus.
Full owned history/cached frame/input queue/consumed total/pending remain exact; C/raw/world/RNG before/after checks and lifecycle/registered-only export constraints remain.
